;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**A [[war crimes]] tribunal in [[Colombia]] begins investigating atrocities during the war which began in the 1960s. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/05/war-crimes-tribunal-investigating-colombias-war-atrocities-180508165257023.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Bosnia]]n prosecutors appeal the acquittal of [[Naser Orić]], former commander of the [[Bosnian Army]] in [[Srebrenica]], who was accused of killing Serb prisoners. [http://www.balkaninsight.com/en/article/bosnian-prosecution-appeals-naser-oric-war-crimes-acquittal-05-08-2018 (''Balkan Insight'')]
*[[Yemeni Crisis (2011–present)]], [[Yemeni Civil War (2015–present)]]
**[[United Arab Emirates takeover of Socotra]]
***[[Yemen]]i political parties, including the [[General People's Congress (Yemen)|General People's Congress]], [[Al-Islah (Yemen)|Al-Islah]] and the [[Southern Movement]] issue a joint statement calling on the [[United Arab Emirates]] to immediately withdraw its troops from [[Socotra]] in the [[Arabian Sea]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/yemeni-parties-demand-uae-withdrawal-from-socotra-/1139364 (Anadolu Agency)] 

;Business and economy
*The heads of [[Serco]] and [[Mitie]] are expected to appear before the [[UK]]'s [[Public Administration and Constitutional Affairs Select Committee]] to testify over the collapse of [[Carillion]]. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/business/2018/05/07/serco-mitie-bosses-face-mps-carillion-collapse/ (''The Telegraph'')]
*[[Economy of Argentina]]
**[[President of Argentina]] [[Mauricio Macri]] announces talks with the [[International Monetary Fund]] on financial support for the country's economy. The [[Central Bank of Argentina]] interest rate is now at 40%, inflation at 25% and the value of the [[Argentine peso]] at a record low. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-44047113 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Grenfell Tower fire]]
**''[[The Guardian]]'' reports that the [[Grenfell Tower]] in [[London]], which burned down last year with the loss of 71 lives, received a quote for non-flammable cladding but it was rejected for a more expensive option which exacerbated the fire. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/may/08/grenfell-tower-more-costly-fire-resistant-cladding-plan-was-dropped (''The Guardian'')]
*[[USS Fitzgerald and MV ACX Crystal collision|USS ''Fitzgerald'' and MV ''ACX Crystal'' collision]]
**Junior officer Lt. j.g. Sarah Coppock, who was navigating when [[USS Fitzgerald|USS ''Fitzgerald'']] when it collided with a civilian ship last year killing seven people, pleads guilty to dereliction of duty and is sentenced to half pay for three months and a punitive letter. [https://www.navytimes.com/news/your-navy/2018/05/08/officer-of-the-deck-during-fatal-fitzgerald-collision-pleads-guilty-at-court-martial/ (Navy Times)]
;Health and environment
*[[List of Ebola outbreaks]]
**A new outbreak of the [[Ebola virus disease]] kills at least 17 people in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/08/drc-confirms-two-cases-of-ebola-in-north-western-town (''The Guardian'')]

;International relations
*[[China–North Korea relations]]
**For the second time in [[Kim–Xi meetings|two months]], [[North Korea]]'s [[List of leaders of North Korea|supreme leader]] [[Kim Jong-un]] meets [[China]]'s [[paramount leader]] [[Xi Jinping]], this time in [[Dalian]]. [https://www.stuff.co.nz/world/asia/103743798/north-korean-leader-kim-jong-un-meets-chinese-president-again-before-trump-summit (Stuff)] [https://www.wsj.com/articles/north-korean-leader-meets-with-chinas-xi-in-unannounced-visit-1525780983 (''The Wall Street Journal'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/05/08/world/asia/kim-jong-un-xi-jinping-china-north-korea.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[United States withdrawal from the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action]]; [[Iran–United States relations]]
**[[Donald Trump]] announces that the [[United States]] will [[United States withdrawal from the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action|withdraw]] from the [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action|Iranian nuclear deal]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/05/08/world/middleeast/trump-iran-nuclear-deal.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[Iran]] says that it remains committed to the agreement but also that it is ready to step up uranium enrichment if the deal is no longer beneficial. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/iran-prepared-for-all-scenarios-if-trump-nixes-nuclear-deal-officials-say/2018/05/08/531047a0-5241-11e8-a6d4-ca1d035642ce_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Terrorism in Greece]]
**[[Greece|Greek]] officials arrest 14 men, all but one of which are [[Greek people|Greek nationals]], on suspicion of funding terrorism. [http://www.ekathimerini.com/228419/article/ekathimerini/news/14-arrested-on-terror-funding-charges (''Kathimerini'')]
*High profile [[China|Chinese]] [[Communist Party of China|Communist Party]] member [[Sun Zhengcai]] is sentenced to life in prison for taking bribes totaling 170 million yuan. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-44036175 (BBC)]
*The [[Metropolitan Police]] of [[London]] announces a review of 21 [[rape]]s and [[sexual assault]]s as well as 12 other offences including violence and [[burglary|burglaries]] over inadequately performed "undeclared casework" by a forensic scientist. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-44044668 (BBC)]

**[[2018 Armenian revolution]]
***[[Armenia]]'s [[Parliament of Armenia|parliament]] elects protest leader [[Nikol Pashinyan]] as the new [[Prime Minister of Armenia|Prime Minister]]. [https://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/armenia-prime-minister-election_us_5af17239e4b0c4f193267607 (''The Huffington Post'')]
*[[Brexit]]
**[[Theresa May]] confirms her trust in [[Secretary of State for Foreign and Commonwealth Affairs|Foreign Secretary]] [[Boris Johnson]] after he called her post-Brexit trade policy with the [[European Union]] "crazy". [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-05-08/may-backs-johnson-after-he-attacks-her-crazy-brexit-trade-plan (Bloomberg)]
